text:
Alex K: Kicking off ACME greenbox on-prem/VPC cluster bring-up in EMEA2. This is an air-gapped delivery. Need infra + delivery + SE on call. Goal: bootstrap nodes, verify GPU drivers, mirror registry, enable KMS, finish handover by Thu EOD. Ping @Maria Chen @Jordan Patel @Samira Rao
Maria Chen: On it. Any constraints on rack placement or power/amp per node? We need exact SKU list to validate PDUs.
Jordan Patel: Got rack plan from logistics — 3x A40 nodes per rack, 2 racks reserved. Power per server ~12A. I'll attach the manifest in a sec.
Ops Bot: Deploy ticket created: INFRA-7892. Status: provisioning queued.
Samira Rao: Quick air-gap checklist draft (will run on bootstrap host):
```
# bootstrap host actions
# 1) mount seed USB and copy certs/images to /opt/seed
mkdir -p /opt/seed && mount /dev/sdb1 /opt/seed
cp -r /opt/seed/images /var/lib/registry
# 2) configure container runtime to use internal mirror
cat > /etc/containers/registries.conf <<EOF
[[registry]]
location = "registry.acme.corp:5000"
EOF
# 3) install GPU driver bundle (offline)
dpkg -i /opt/seed/drivers/nvidia-driver-*.deb || rpm -Uvh /opt/seed/drivers/nvidia-*.rpm
modprobe nvidia || echo "modprobe failed"
# 4) enable nvidia container runtime and device plugin
# 5) kubeadm init with --apiserver-advertise-address and local certs
```
Alex K: Important — registry mirror must use customer's internal registry (registry.acme.corp:5000), we can't use internet egress. Maria/Jordan ensure TLS certs and credentials are in the delivery USB.
Maria Chen: Certs are on seed USB under /seed/certs, and we have .dockerconfig.json. Will verify once node online.
Jordan Patel: Shipping delayed by ~6 hours; ETA to datacenter start work 1804126800. May push handoff by half day.
Samira Rao: Validation smoke tests (to run after nodes join):
- GPU smoke: `docker run --gpus all --rm nvidia/cuda:11.7-base nvidia-smi`
- Perf: deploy a tiny model container and run a 1-min throughput test (target 50 tokens/s for sanity)
- Kube: check `kubectl get nodes`, device plugin logs, and `journalctl -u kubelet` for errors
Alex K: Cost note — ACME requested reserved capacity estimate. Use 2 racks * 3 A40s = 6 GPUs initially (note: Jordan said 2 racks reserved earlier, double-check). Project monthly infra estimate attached in ticket INFRA-7892. Keep local caching to reduce egress charges.
Maria Chen: Confirmed GPU drivers tested on lab image. I'll upload driver bundle to /seed/images.
Jordan Patel: Once booted, I'll run these commands and paste logs. Also need to ensure MTU across switches set to 9000 for better RDMA/NIC performance.
Ops Bot: INFRA-7892 updated: status -> in-progress by jordanp.
Alex K: If anything blocks validation, escalate to eng-sre and tag @oncall. Also record iptables/nft rules; customer needs explicit open ports list (API, metrics, kube-apiserver, etc.).
Samira Rao: Final handoff checklist for SE: endpoint URLs, api-key provisioning instructions, KMS key ID/ARN, sample inference request, rollout/rollback steps, and exact command snippets for adding nodes. I'll prepare a small runbook note to attach to the ticket.
Jordan Patel: Will post a short follow-up with `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and `nvidia-smi` outputs after onsite.
Maria Chen: :white_check_mark: prepping USB with certs and images now.
